messages:
deploy-bot: :warning: MANUAL HOLDPOINT: Release candidate v2026.03.20-rc4 ready for prod deploy in us-west-2. Commit: 3a9f7d8. Canary target: 5% on az1. Change window 22:00-23:00 UTC. Safety checks: unit/e2e passed. Manual approval required from oncall or release owner before proceeding. @ops-jen @alex @jamie — please ack or provide blockers. To approve run `/release approve 1967890123` or react with :white_check_mark: 

alex: Looking at the changelog now. Two items: image-cache TTL tweak and runtime quant config. Where are the release notes? link?

jamie: Rollback plan? If the quant config regresses perf we should pin back to v2026.03.19. What's the immediate rollback command?

ops-jen: Can we get canary preflight metrics (latency, p50/p95, error-rate) from canary-runner? Need to confirm no mem growth. Also confirm model variant pinned (fp16 vs int8).

matt: Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2026.03.20-rc4.md — includes perf numbers from staging. Variant is `redwood-model-3b@fp16` for this rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary preflight snapshot: p50=38ms, p95=120ms, error_rate=0.45%, mem_rss=9.6GiB on g4dn. No OOM observed. All checks green except a small perf delta on long contexts in staging. Details: https://canary.redwood.internal/runs/1967890123

jamie: Rollback command (tested in dry-run):
```
/release rollback --env prod --tag v2026.03.19 --reason "quant config regression"
```
We'll need to ensure KV cache invalidation step after rollback.

sara: Could we pin traffic to dedicated capacity for the first 10m of canary? Safer to avoid cross-tenant variability. If ops-jen signs off on metrics I can approve.

ops-jen: I pulled the canary logs for the last 30m — no spike in tail latency, error traces look unrelated to model (upstream auth retries). Approving conditioned on pinning traffic to dedicated pool for 10m and a post-deploy smoke test. +1 to rollback plan.

alex: Quick doc check: confirm release note includes config diff and the eval that caught the long-context perf delta. I see it in the link. ok from me after the dedicated pin.

sara: Approved. I've updated the deployment config: `traffic: { canary_percent: 5, dedicated_pool: true, dedicated_duration: 600 }`

ops-jen: Approve — proceeding with manual prod hold release. `/release approve 1967890123`

deploy-bot: :lock: Approval received from ops-jen, sara. Proceeding with canary rollout to prod (5% az1 -> dedicated pool). Will post updates at each step. If any metric crosses thresholds will pause and notify. Commit: 3a9f7d8.

alex: Thanks — monitoring dashboards up. I'll watch rollback path and be on standby.
